description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Biggs)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Biggs)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00, critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Earth abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Biggs)], removes [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Biggs)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Biggs)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100%, instant cast speed for Earth abilities, grants [Weakness +9% Boost 1]/[Weakness +15% Boost 1]/[Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using Earth abilities if 0-1/2-3/4+ Core/Beyond allies are alive, grants [Critical Damage +50% 1] to the user after using Earth abilities if 4+ Core/Beyond allies are alive

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
